germination first stage.name: Germination First Stage
germination first stage.description: Seed absorbs water (imbibition). Radicle (root) just begins to emerge. Cotyledons still enclosed.
germination first stage.key_features: Slight swelling of seed, tiny white root tip visible.
germination first stage.duration: Usually 1–3 days depending on species & temperature.
germination first stage.care_tips: Keep moist but not waterlogged. Temperature 20–30°C ideal for most plants.

germination second stage.name: Germination Second Stage
germination second stage.description: Radicle elongates and starts anchoring. Hypocotyl begins to emerge.
germination second stage.key_features: Clear root growth, seed coat may start splitting.
germination second stage.care_tips: Continue gentle moisture. Avoid disturbing the root.

germination third stage.name: Germination Third Stage
germination third stage.description: Shoot (plumule) emerges and pushes upward. Cotyledons begin to open or appear above soil.
germination third stage.key_features: Visible shoot, cotyledons expanding, first true leaves may start forming.
germination third stage.care_tips: Provide light once shoot emerges. Reduce watering frequency slightly.

leaf.name: Leaf Stage
leaf.description: Image primarily shows leaf structure (diagnostic class).
leaf.key_features: Leaf shape, venation, color, any disease signs.
leaf.care_tips: Useful for health diagnosis and nutrient monitoring.

mature stage.name: Mature Stage
mature stage.description: Plant is fully developed and ready for flowering or harvest depending on crop.
mature stage.key_features: Full canopy, reproductive structures may appear, maximum biomass.
mature stage.care_tips: Switch to bloom/fruit nutrients if applicable. Monitor pests.

post mature stage.name: Post Mature Stage
post mature stage.description: Plant has completed main growth. May show signs of senescence or be ready for harvest.
post mature stage.key_features: Yellowing leaves, reduced new growth, possible fruit/seed maturity.
post mature stage.care_tips: Reduce watering and nitrogen. Prepare for harvest or seed collection.

premature stage.name: Premature Stage
premature stage.description: Rapid vegetative growth phase before flowering/fruiting readiness.
premature stage.key_features: Dense foliage, thicker stem, plant size increasing fast.
premature stage.care_tips: Higher nutrient demand (especially nitrogen). Support if needed.

raw.name: Raw / Unclassified
raw.description: Image does not clearly match a defined growth stage (possibly poor quality or mixed content).
raw.key_features: Unclear features, blur, or mixed elements.
raw.care_tips: Try uploading a clearer, closer image of a single plant/seed.

seeds.name: Seeds Stage
seeds.description: Dormant or dry seed before any germination activity.
seeds.key_features: Intact seed coat, no root/shoot emergence.
seeds.care_tips: Store in cool, dry place until sowing.
